---
title: "Section V: attending an over-demanded school"
---

This notebook writes to `output/` every table of Section V of the paper and of its Appendix C: Table III (`lottery_balance.tex`),
Table IV (`lottery_college.tex`) and Appendix Tables C.1 to C.6 (`lottery_sample_construction.tex`, `lottery_characteristics.tex`,
`complier_alternatives.tex`, `lottery_college_offer.tex`, `lottery_college_first_choice.tex`, `lottery_followup.tex`). It also writes
the skeleton draft's admission-scores table (`lottery_scores.tex`) and its Table A3, the historical records of the over-demanded
schools (`lottery_od_historical_records.tex`, `lottery_od_historical_va_checks.tex` and the macros `lottery_od_historical_macros.tex`;
in the paper, the records table of Section IV and a table of Appendix B), and prints the numbers of Section V's text and of Appendix
C's prose. It reads the four data files in the shared data folder
`<home>/Dropbox/Effect SAE on SUA/data/finalized_design_v1/section5/` (see the README).

```{r setup, error = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(fixest)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = FALSE)   # a failed check stops the knit

home <- ifelse(Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE") != "", Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE"), path.expand("~"))
data_dir <- file.path(home, "Dropbox", "Effect SAE on SUA", "data", "finalized_design_v1", "section5")
panel <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "section5_panel.rds"))                 # one row per applicant child
applications <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "section5_applications.rds"))   # one row per application of the population (Table C.1; the footnote of V.A)
entrants <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "section5_entrants.rds"))           # one row per 9th-grade entry under SAE (Table C.2, column 3)
schools <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "table_a3_panel.rds"))
dir.create("output", showWarnings = FALSE)

setFixest_vcov(all = "hetero")            # robust SEs; OLS with the N/(N-K) factor and t(N-K) p-values, as Stata's robust
setFixest_estimation(fixef.rm = "none")   # keep chance groups that hold a single child

controls <- c("GPA8_Z", "ES_MUJER", "PRIORITARIO", "ALTO", "ORIGIN_OD")
years <- paste0(min(panel$YEAR), "--", max(panel$YEAR))   # the application years

college <- c(
  GRAD     = "Graduated from high school",
  GRAD_REGULAR = "\\quad Through regular secondary education",
  GRAD_ADULT   = "\\quad Through adult secondary education",
  APPLIED  = "Applied to a college program",
  ASSIGNED = "Assigned a college seat",
  INSUA    = "Enrolled (In SUA)",
  OUTSIDE  = "Enrolled (Outside SUA)"
)

scores <- c(
  LM_Z_MAX      = "Reading--mathematics mean",
  NEM_Z_LATEST  = "NEM score",
  RANK_Z_LATEST = "Ranking score"
)

# the windows of the panel's on-time outcomes and the last year of the records (Table C.6 and the notes of Tables C.4 and C.6)
ON_TIME_GRADUATION <- 4L       # graduation by the fourth school year after the application year
ON_TIME_COLLEGE <- 5L          # college outcomes by the admission process five years after it
LAST_SCHOOL_YEAR <- 2025L      # the year-end school records run through the 2025 school year
LAST_COLLEGE_PROCESS <- 2026L  # the college admission and higher-education enrollment records run through 2026

stars <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.01, "$^{***}$", ifelse(p < 0.05, "$^{**}$", ifelse(p < 0.1, "$^{*}$", "")))
num <- function(x, d) sub("^-(0\\.0+)$", "\\1", sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f"), x))   # never "-0.00"
comma <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
tex_row <- function(label, cells) paste0("      ", label, " & ", paste(cells, collapse = " & "), "\\\\\n")

# a constructed 0/1 flag: its share printed; it stops unless the flag takes both values
flag <- function(x, what) {
  if (anyNA(x) || !all(x %in% 0:1) || n_distinct(x) != 2L) stop(what, ": a 0/1 flag taking both values expected")
  message(sprintf("%s: share %.4f of %s", what, mean(x), comma(length(x))))
  invisible(x)
}

# the first line of each table file of Section V and Appendix C (the scores table and Table A3's files keep their form)
write_tex <- function(tex, file) cat("% Generated by Section5_IV.Rmd\n", tex, file = file.path("output", file), sep = "")

# coefficient on the instrument z (OLS) or on attendance (2SLS), SE, p-value and N, one row per model, the models' dependent
# variables y in their order (checked); 2SLS p-values from the normal distribution, as ivreg2's
effect <- function(fit, y, z = "OFFER") {
  models <- if (inherits(fit, "fixest_multi")) as.list(fit) else list(fit)
  stopifnot(identical(unname(map_chr(models, function(m) deparse(m$fml[[2]]))), y))   # each model's dependent variable is its label
  bind_rows(map(models, function(m) {
    iv <- isTRUE(m$is_iv)
    term <- if (iv) "fit_D_OD" else z
    p <- if (iv) 2 * pnorm(-abs(tstat(m)[[term]])) else pvalue(m)[[term]]
    tibble(est = coef(m)[[term]], se = se(m)[[term]], p = p, n = nobs(m))
  }))
}

# the rows of an outcome table (Tables IV, C.4 and C.5): each outcome's mean without the offer and its effect, on time and ever, in pp
outcome_body <- function(est) {
  map_chr(names(college), function(k) {
    ot <- filter(est, var == paste0(k, "_OT"))
    ever <- filter(est, var == paste0(k, "_EVER"))
    stopifnot(nrow(ot) == 1L, nrow(ever) == 1L)   # each outcome's row on time and ever, once
    paste0(
      tex_row(college[[k]], c(num(100 * ot$mean, 2), paste0(num(100 * ot$est, 2), stars(ot$p)),
                              num(100 * ever$mean, 2), paste0(num(100 * ever$est, 2), stars(ever$p)))),
      tex_row("", c("", paste0("(", num(100 * ot$se, 2), ")"), "", paste0("(", num(100 * ever$se, 2), ")")))
    )
  })
}
```

# Table III: balance and enrollment

Each row's variable is regressed on the offer, with the column's fixed effects.

```{r table-III}
lottery <- panel %>%
  filter(LOTTERY_SAMPLE) %>%
  mutate(ANY_SCHOOL = flag(as.integer(!is.na(ENTRY_RBD)), "ANY_SCHOOL"))   # enrolled at any school in the entry year
lottery_1000 <- filter(lottery, LOTTERY_SAMPLE_THOUSANDTHS)

rows2 <- tribble(
  ~var,          ~panel, ~label,                         ~label2,                             ~scale, ~digits,
  "N_CLASS",     "A",    "Choices ranked",               "",                                  1,      3,
  "N_OD",        "A",    "Over-demanded schools ranked", "",                                  1,      3,
  "FC_OD",       "A",    "Ranked an over-demanded",      "\\quad school first (\\%)",         100,    2,
  "GPA8_Z",      "B",    "8th-grade average (SD)",       "",                                  1,      3,
  "ES_MUJER",    "B",    "Female (\\%)",                 "",                                  100,    2,
  "PRIORITARIO", "B",    "Low-income (\\%)",             "",                                  100,    2,
  "ALTO",        "B",    "Top 20\\% of the school's",    "\\quad grade ranking (\\%)",        100,    2,
  "ORIGIN_OD",   "B",    "Enrolled at an over-demanded", "\\quad school in 8th grade (\\%)",  100,    2,
  "D_OD",        "C",    "Attends an over-demanded",     "\\quad school (\\%)",               100,    2,
  "ANY_SCHOOL",  "C",    "Enrolled at any school (\\%)", "",                                  100,    2
)
balance_vars <- rows2$var[rows2$panel != "C"]   # the eight rows of the joint test

fits2 <- list(
  feols(.[rows2$var] ~ OFFER | YEAR, lottery),
  feols(.[rows2$var] ~ OFFER + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP, lottery),
  feols(.[rows2$var] ~ OFFER + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP_THOUSANDTHS, lottery_1000)
)
est2 <- map(fits2, effect, y = rows2$var)
mean2 <- colMeans(lottery[lottery$OFFER == 0, rows2$var], na.rm = TRUE)
stopifnot(all(panel$ALTO[panel$YEAR == 2016] == 0))   # the notes: the top-20% indicator, not recorded in 2016, is 0 for its applicants

# joint F as in Abdulkadiroglu et al. (2017): Stata's mvreg, then test; on the children with all eight rows
joint_test <- function(d, rhs) {
  d <- drop_na(d, all_of(balance_vars))
  fit <- feols(as.formula(paste(".[balance_vars] ~ OFFER", rhs)), d)
  z <- resid(feols(as.formula(paste("OFFER ~ 1", rhs)), d))
  b <- coef(fit)[, "OFFER"]
  e <- resid(fit)
  df <- nobs(fit[[1]]) - fit[[1]]$nparams
  V <- crossprod(e) / df / sum(z^2)   # covariance of the eight coefficients
  f_stat <- drop(b %*% solve(V, b)) / length(b)
  tibble(F = f_stat, df = df, p = pf(f_stat, length(b), df, lower.tail = FALSE), n = nrow(d))
}
joint2 <- bind_rows(
  joint_test(lottery, "| YEAR"),
  joint_test(lottery, "+ i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP"),
  joint_test(lottery_1000, "+ i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP_THOUSANDTHS")
)
as.data.frame(joint2)
```

```{r table-III-tex}
body2 <- map_chr(seq_len(nrow(rows2)), function(i) {
  r <- rows2[i, ]
  cells <- map_chr(est2, function(e) paste0(num(r$scale * e$est[i], r$digits), stars(e$p[i])))
  ses <- map_chr(est2, function(e) paste0("(", num(r$scale * e$se[i], r$digits), ")"))
  paste0(tex_row(r$label, c(num(r$scale * mean2[[r$var]], r$digits), cells)),
         tex_row(r$label2, c("", ses)))
})
with_gpa <- comma(c(sum(lottery$OFFER == 0 & !is.na(lottery$GPA8_Z)), joint2$n))

note2 <- paste0(
  "Notes: The sample is the lottery sample of Section~\\ref{sec:lottery-data}. Column (1) is the mean among students without an offer. ",
  "Columns (2) to (4) report the coefficient on the offer in a regression of the row's variable on the offer, with heteroskedasticity-robust ",
  "standard errors in parentheses, and differ in what they hold fixed: column (2) the application year only; columns (3) and (4) the chance ",
  "group (the chance rounded to the nearest hundredth or thousandth) and the application year, on the students whose group holds a ",
  "student with an offer and a student without one. The joint test is the $F$-test that the coefficients of the eight rows of Panels A ",
  "and B are jointly zero in a multivariate regression of those rows on the offer with the column's fixed effects. The 8th-grade ",
  "average row and the joint test cover the students with that average: ", with_gpa[1], ", ", with_gpa[2], ", ", with_gpa[3],
  ", and ", with_gpa[4], " in columns (1) to (4). Rows marked \\% report a share in column (1) and a difference ",
  "in pp in columns (2) to (4). Choices ranked counts the choices the student ranked: a school, or a classroom at a school with more ",
  "than one 9th-grade classroom. Over-demanded schools ranked counts the distinct over-demanded schools among them. The top-20\\% ",
  "indicator is not recorded in the 2016 process and is set to 0 for its applicants. Panel C refers to the annual enrollment census ",
  "of the entry year. $^{***}$p$<$0.01, $^{**}$p$<$0.05, $^{*}$p$<$0.1."
)

tex2 <- paste0(
  "\\begin{table}[htbp]\\singlespacing\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.0}\n",
  "   \\caption{Lottery Balance and Enrollment, Application Years ", years, "}\\label{tab: lottery balance}\n",
  "   \\centerline{\\scalebox{0.85}{\\begin{tabular}{lcccc}\n",
  "      \\toprule\n",
  "                   & \\shortstack{Without an\\\\offer} & No & \\multicolumn{2}{c}{Chance-group controls}\\\\\n",
  "      \\cmidrule(lr){4-5}\n",
  "                   & mean & controls & Hundredths & Thousandths\\\\\n",
  "                   & (1) & (2) & (3) & (4)\\\\\n",
  "      \\midrule\n",
  "      \\multicolumn{5}{l}{\\textit{Panel A. Ranked list}}\\\\\n",
  paste(body2[rows2$panel == "A"], collapse = ""),
  "      \\midrule\n",
  "      \\multicolumn{5}{l}{\\textit{Panel B. Characteristics}}\\\\\n",
  paste(body2[rows2$panel == "B"], collapse = ""),
  "      \\midrule\n",
  "      \\multicolumn{5}{l}{\\textit{Panel C. Enrollment in the entry year}}\\\\\n",
  paste(body2[rows2$panel == "C"], collapse = ""),
  "      \\midrule\n",
  tex_row("$N$", comma(c(sum(lottery$OFFER == 0), nrow(lottery), nrow(lottery), nrow(lottery_1000)))),
  tex_row("Chance groups", c("", "", comma(n_distinct(lottery$CHANCE_GROUP)), comma(n_distinct(lottery_1000$CHANCE_GROUP_THOUSANDTHS)))),
  tex_row("$F$-test for joint significance", c("", num(joint2$F, 2))),
  tex_row("$p$-value", c("", num(joint2$p, 3))),
  "      \\bottomrule\n",
```

# Table IV: graduation and college outcomes

Each outcome is regressed on attendance at an over-demanded school by 2SLS, with the offer as the instrument.

```{r table-IV}
sample3 <- drop_na(lottery, all_of(controls))
stopifnot(nrow(sample3) == 175869L)   # Table IV's note gives DEMRE's 345 validation and recognition completers among these 175,869 children
vars3 <- c(paste0(names(college), "_OT"), paste0(names(college), "_EVER"))

first_stage <- feols(D_OD ~ OFFER + .[controls] + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP, sample3)
fit3 <- feols(.[vars3] ~ .[controls] + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP | D_OD ~ OFFER, sample3,
              ssc = ssc(K.adj = FALSE))   # 2SLS SEs without the N/(N-K) factor, as ivreg2's robust
fs3 <- effect(first_stage, "D_OD")
est3 <- effect(fit3, vars3) %>%
  mutate(var = vars3, mean = colMeans(sample3[sample3$OFFER == 0, vars3]))
```

```{r table-IV-tex}
note3 <- paste0(
  "Notes: The sample is the ", comma(nrow(sample3)), " students of the lottery sample with every characteristic of ",
  "Section~\\ref{sec:lottery-data}. Columns (2) and (4) report 2SLS estimates of the effect of attending an over-demanded school, with ",
  "the offer as the instrument, chance-group and application-year fixed effects, and the characteristics as controls ",
  "(Section~\\ref{sec:lottery-estimation}); the first stage is ", num(100 * fs3$est, 2), " pp (", num(100 * fs3$se, 2), "). Columns (1) ",
  "and (3) are means among the students without an offer, in \\%; the effects are in pp. Heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors in ",
  "parentheses. On time and ever are defined in Section~\\ref{sec:lottery-data}. A student who completes secondary school in adult ",
  "education counts as graduated; the two indented rows divide graduation by route, and a student who also completes twelfth grade in ",
  "regular secondary education counts in the regular row. DEMRE's registration records list 345 students who completed secondary school ",
  "through validation exams or the recognition of studies abroad, two routes outside the year-end school records; they count as not ",
  "graduated. A student who enrolled through SUA and outside it in the same year counts in the In SUA row. $^{***}$p$<$0.01, ",
  "$^{**}$p$<$0.05, $^{*}$p$<$0.1."
)

tex3 <- paste0(
  "\\begin{table}[htbp]\\singlespacing\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.2}\n",
```

# Admission scores

The same 2SLS, each score among the children who have it.

```{r scores-table}
fit4 <- feols(.[names(scores)] ~ .[controls] + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP | D_OD ~ OFFER, sample3,
              ssc = ssc(K.adj = FALSE))
est4 <- effect(fit4, names(scores)) %>%
  mutate(var = names(scores), mean = colMeans(sample3[sample3$OFFER == 0, names(scores)], na.rm = TRUE))

body4 <- map_chr(seq_along(scores), function(i) {
  paste0(
    tex_row(scores[[i]], c(num(est4$mean[i], 3), paste0(num(est4$est[i], 3), stars(est4$p[i])), comma(est4$n[i]))),
    tex_row("", c("", paste0("(", num(est4$se[i], 3), ")"), ""))
  )
})

note4 <- paste0(
  "Notes: Each row's sample is the children of the lottery sample with the score and every characteristic of Section 3.3. Column (2) ",
  "reports 2SLS estimates of the effect of attending an over-demanded school, specified as in Table~\\ref{tab: lottery college}; ",
  "column (1) is the mean among the children without an offer. Scores are in standard deviations within the admission process; a ",
  "child with scores from more than one process enters with her highest reading--mathematics mean and her latest NEM and ranking ",
  "scores. Heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors in parentheses. $^{***}$p$<$0.01, $^{**}$p$<$0.05, $^{*}$p$<$0.1."
)

tex4 <- paste0(
  "\\begin{table}[htbp]\n",
  "   \\caption{Effect of Attending an Over-Demanded School on Admission Scores}\\label{tab: lottery scores}\n",
  "   \\centerline{\\scalebox{0.85}{\\begin{tabular}{lccc}\n",
  "      \\toprule\n",
  "                   & Non-offered & 2SLS & $N$\\\\\n",
  "                   & mean &  & \\\\\n",
  "                   & (1) & (2) & (3)\\\\\n",
  "      \\midrule\n",
  paste(body4, collapse = ""),
  "      \\bottomrule\n",
  "   \\end{tabular}}}\n",
  "   \\par\\smallskip{\\footnotesize ", note4, "}\n",
  "\\end{table}\n"
)
cat(tex4, file = "output/lottery_scores.tex")
cat(tex4)
```

# Appendix Table C.1: the lottery sample's construction

Each step's count: the applications of the population, then the children.

```{r table-C1}
funnel <- c(applications = nrow(applications), eighth_grade = sum(applications$ENROLLED_8TH_GRADE_APRIL),
            children = sum(applications$KEPT), lottery_sample = nrow(lottery), every_characteristic = nrow(sample3))
stopifnot(funnel[["children"]] == nrow(panel),
          identical(applications$MRUN[applications$KEPT], panel$MRUN))   # the kept applications are the panel's children, in its order
funnel

tex_c1 <- c(
  "\\begin{table}[!htbp]",
  "\\singlespacing\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.2}",
  "\\centering",
  "\\caption{Construction of the Ninth-Grade Lottery Sample}",
  "\\label{tab: lottery sample construction}",
  "\\small",
  "\\begin{tabular*}{\\textwidth}{@{\\extracolsep{\\fill}}p{0.76\\textwidth}r@{}}",
  "\\toprule",
  "Restriction & Remaining \\\\",
  "\\midrule",
  paste0("Ninth-grade applications involving an over-demanded school & ", comma(funnel[["applications"]]), " \\\\"),
  paste0("Enrollment in eighth grade in the application year & ", comma(funnel[["eighth_grade"]]), " \\\\"),
  paste0("No preceding-year application; earliest remaining application per student & ", comma(funnel[["children"]]), " \\\\"),
  paste0("Probability of an offer strictly between zero and one & ", comma(funnel[["lottery_sample"]]), " \\\\"),
  paste0("All characteristics used as regression controls observed & ", comma(funnel[["every_characteristic"]]), " \\\\"),
  "\\bottomrule",
  "\\end{tabular*}",
  "\\par\\smallskip",
  "\\begin{minipage}{\\textwidth}\\footnotesize",
  paste0("Notes: Processes ", years, ". The first two rows count applications; the remaining rows count unique students. Of the ",
         comma(funnel[["children"]]), " students, ", comma(funnel[["children"]] - funnel[["lottery_sample"]]), " have offer probability ",
         "zero or one and do not enter the propensity-score lottery sample. The final row defines the sample for the main regressions ",
         "with controls. Each admission-score regression further requires the corresponding score."),
  "\\end{minipage}",
  "\\end{table}"
)
write_tex(paste0(paste(tex_c1, collapse = "\n"), "\n"), "lottery_sample_construction.tex")
cat(tex_c1, sep = "\n")
```

# Appendix Table C.2: the children whose attendance depends on the offer

Column (1) is the 2SLS of $X(D - 1/2)$ on attendance, the offer the instrument, with the chance groups as fixed effects and each child
weighted by $1/(p_c(1 - p_c))$, $p_c$ the offer share of her chance group among the row's children, so that every child whose
attendance depends on the offer counts once; heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors without the N/(N-K) factor. Columns (2) and (3)
are means.

```{r table-C2}
rows_c2 <- rows2[rows2$panel == "B", ]   # the five characteristics, as Table III's Panel B
col1 <- bind_rows(map(rows_c2$var, function(v) {
  d <- lottery %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[v]])) %>%
    group_by(CHANCE_GROUP) %>%
    mutate(W = 1 / (mean(OFFER) * (1 - mean(OFFER)))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(X = as.numeric(.data[[v]]), Y = X * (D_OD - 0.5))
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(d$W)))   # each chance group holds a child with an offer and one without, among the row's children
  fit <- feols(Y ~ 1 | CHANCE_GROUP | D_OD ~ OFFER, d, weights = ~W, ssc = ssc(K.adj = FALSE))
  mutate(effect(fit, "Y"), var = v, mean_all = mean(d$X))
}))

# column (3): the entries; low income is SAE's flag with a main-stage application and the SEP roster of the entry year without one
entrants3 <- mutate(entrants, LOW_INCOME = if_else(MAIN_STAGE_9, PRIORITARIO, LOW_INCOME_SEP_ENTRY_YEAR))
entrant_cols <- c(GPA8_Z = "GPA8_Z", ES_MUJER = "FEMALE", PRIORITARIO = "LOW_INCOME", ALTO = "ALTO", ORIGIN_OD = "ORIGIN_OD")
col3 <- bind_rows(map(names(entrant_cols), function(v) {
  x <- entrants3[[entrant_cols[[v]]]]
  tibble(var = v, mean3 = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), n3 = sum(!is.na(x)))
}))
overlap <- filter(entrants, MRUN %in% lottery$MRUN)   # every entry of a child of column (2)
stopifnot(max(table(entrants$MRUN)) == 2L)   # no child enters more than twice: the entries less the children count those who entered twice
c2_counts <- c(twice = nrow(entrants) - n_distinct(entrants$MRUN), overlap_entries = nrow(overlap),
               overlap_children = n_distinct(overlap$MRUN), fill = sum(!entrants$MAIN_STAGE_9), main_stage = sum(entrants$MAIN_STAGE_9),
               eighth_grade = sum(!is.na(entrants$ORIGIN_OD)))
stopifnot(identical(col1$var, rows_c2$var), identical(col3$var, rows_c2$var),   # the three columns in the rows' order
          c2_counts[["main_stage"]] == col3$n3[col3$var == "ALTO"], c2_counts[["eighth_grade"]] == col3$n3[col3$var == "ORIGIN_OD"])
as.data.frame(left_join(col1, col3, by = "var"))
c2_counts
```

```{r table-C2-tex}
body_c2 <- map_chr(seq_len(nrow(rows_c2)), function(i) {
  r <- rows_c2[i, ]
  paste0(tex_row(r$label, c(num(r$scale * col1$est[i], r$digits), num(r$scale * col1$mean_all[i], r$digits),
                            num(r$scale * col3$mean3[i], r$digits))),
         tex_row(r$label2, c(paste0("(", num(r$scale * col1$se[i], r$digits), ")"), "", "")))
})

note_c2 <- paste0(
```

# Appendix Table C.3: where the children whose attendance depends on the offer go without it

Each share is minus the 2SLS effect of attendance on 1[the entry school's type] x (1 - attendance), specified as in Table IV
(Abdulkadiroglu et al. 2017, Table VII).

```{r table-C3}
destinations <- c(publicly_funded_outside = "Other publicly funded school", fee_paying = "Fee-paying private school",
                  no_record = "No entry-year enrollment record")
sample_c3 <- mutate(sample3,
                    PUBLIC = flag((ENTRY_SCHOOL_TYPE == "publicly_funded_outside") * (1L - D_OD), "PUBLIC"),
                    FEE = flag((ENTRY_SCHOOL_TYPE == "fee_paying") * (1L - D_OD), "FEE"),
                    NONE = flag((ENTRY_SCHOOL_TYPE == "no_record") * (1L - D_OD), "NONE"))
fit_c3 <- feols(c(PUBLIC, FEE, NONE) ~ .[controls] + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP | D_OD ~ OFFER, sample_c3,
                ssc = ssc(K.adj = FALSE))
est_c3 <- effect(fit_c3, c("PUBLIC", "FEE", "NONE")) %>%
  mutate(type = names(destinations), share = -est)
stopifnot(abs(sum(est_c3$share) - 1) < 1e-8)   # without the offer, every such child is in one of the three
as.data.frame(est_c3)

tex_c3 <- c(
  "\\begin{table}[!htbp]",
  "\\singlespacing\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.2}",
  "\\centering",
  "\\caption{Compliers' Entry-Year Destinations without an Offer}",
  "\\label{tab: complier alternatives}",
  "\\small",
  "\\begin{tabular*}{0.85\\textwidth}{@{\\extracolsep{\\fill}}lc@{}}",
  "\\toprule",
  "Destination & Share (\\%) \\\\",
  "\\midrule",
  paste0(destinations[est_c3$type], " & ", num(100 * est_c3$share, 1), " \\\\"),
  "\\bottomrule",
  "\\end{tabular*}",
  "\\par\\smallskip",
  "\\begin{minipage}{\\textwidth}\\footnotesize",
  paste0("Notes: Shares for students whose attendance at an over-demanded school depends on an offer, estimated by 2SLS as described in ",
         "Section~\\ref{sec:lottery-balance}. Other publicly funded schools are outside the fixed set of ", comma(sum(schools$IS_OD)), ". ",
         "These are estimated counterfactual destinations rather than observed classifications of individual compliers."),
  "\\end{minipage}",
  "\\end{table}"
)
write_tex(paste0(paste(tex_c3, collapse = "\n"), "\n"), "complier_alternatives.tex")
cat(tex_c3, sep = "\n")
```

```{r table-C4}
est_c4 <- effect(fit_c4, vars3) %>%
  mutate(var = vars3, mean = colMeans(sample3[sample3$OFFER == 0, vars3]))
```

# Appendix Table C.5: first-choice admission lotteries

Table IV's 2SLS with a first-choice offer as the instrument and one fixed effect per first-choice admission lottery, on the children
of the first-choice sample with every characteristic, in or outside the lottery sample.

```{r table-C5}
first_choice <- panel %>%
  filter(FIRST_CHOICE_SAMPLE) %>%
  drop_na(all_of(controls))
first_stage_c5 <- feols(D_OD ~ FIRST_CHOICE_OFFER + .[controls] | FIRST_CHOICE_LOTTERY, first_choice)
fit_c5 <- feols(.[vars3] ~ .[controls] | FIRST_CHOICE_LOTTERY | D_OD ~ FIRST_CHOICE_OFFER, first_choice,
                ssc = ssc(K.adj = FALSE))
fs_c5 <- effect(first_stage_c5, "D_OD", z = "FIRST_CHOICE_OFFER")
est_c5 <- effect(fit_c5, vars3) %>%
  mutate(var = vars3, mean = colMeans(first_choice[first_choice$FIRST_CHOICE_OFFER == 0, vars3]))
c(children = nrow(first_choice), lotteries = n_distinct(first_choice$FIRST_CHOICE_LOTTERY))
c(first_stage_pp = 100 * fs_c5$est, se_pp = 100 * fs_c5$se)
```

# Appendix Table C.6: the outcome horizons by application year

```{r table-C6}
followup <- tibble(YEAR = sort(unique(panel$YEAR))) %>%
  mutate(graduation = YEAR + ON_TIME_GRADUATION, process = YEAR + ON_TIME_COLLEGE, more_years = LAST_SCHOOL_YEAR - graduation)
stopifnot(all(followup$more_years == LAST_COLLEGE_PROCESS - followup$process))   # the same follow-up for graduation and college
# the windows against the outcome columns (the children with every outcome): in the application year with no further follow-up, each
# on-time outcome equals its ever outcome; in the year with one more year of records, each outcome has a child whose ever outcome is above it
observed <- drop_na(panel, all_of(vars3))
no_more <- filter(observed, YEAR == followup$YEAR[followup$more_years == 0])
one_more <- filter(observed, YEAR == followup$YEAR[followup$more_years == 1])
cols_ot <- paste0(names(college), "_OT")
cols_ever <- paste0(names(college), "_EVER")
stopifnot(all(no_more[cols_ot] == no_more[cols_ever]), all(colSums(one_more[cols_ever] > one_more[cols_ot]) > 0))
as.data.frame(followup)
```

# Table A3 of the skeleton draft: historical records of the over-demanded schools

Panel A compares the over-demanded schools with the other SAE schools; Panel B repeats its value-added comparison under other specifications.

```{r tableA3}
catalogue <- filter(schools, IN_CATALOGUE)   # Table A3's schools
common <- filter(catalogue, IS_COMMON)       # with every measure of Panel A

panel_a <- common %>%
  group_by(GROUP) %>%
  summarise(across(c(NEM_PERCENTILE_MEAN, LM_PERCENTILE_MEAN, VA_HEAD, ASSIGNED_ANY_MEAN, ASSIGNED_TOP10_MEAN,
                     ASSIGNED_TOP25_MEAN, ASSIGNED_TOP50_MEAN), mean),
            schools = n())
as.data.frame(panel_a)

# SD with three decimals, a negative in math mode
sd3 <- function(x, math = "$%s$") ifelse(startsWith(num(x, 3), "-"), sprintf(math, num(x, 3)), num(x, 3))

# a group's mean value added under one fit; SE of the mean: sigma_e * sqrt(sum(1 / students)) / schools
va_mean <- function(fit, min_students = 0) {
  catalogue %>%
    select(GROUP, va = all_of(paste0("VA_", fit)), students = all_of(paste0("VA_N_", fit)), sigma = all_of(paste0("SIGMA_E_M_", fit))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(va), students >= min_students) %>%
    group_by(GROUP) %>%
    summarise(mean = mean(va), se = sigma[1] * sqrt(sum(1 / students)) / n(), schools = n(), students = sum(students))
}
checks <- list(
  "Main estimate (Panel A)"                = va_mean("HEAD"),
  "Eighth-grade GPA on the national scale" = va_mean("REG"),
  "Eighth-grade GPA left out"              = va_mean("NOGPA"),
  "Parent questionnaire left out"          = va_mean("NOPAR"),
  "Eighth-grade SIMCE scores only"         = va_mean("SPL"),
  "Schools with 30 or more graduates"      = va_mean("HEAD", min_students = 30),
  "Class of 2013 only"                     = va_mean("C13"),
  "Class of 2015 only"                     = va_mean("C15")
)
as.data.frame(bind_rows(checks, .id = "specification"))
```

```{r tableA3-tex}
labels_a <- c(
  NEM_PERCENTILE_MEAN = "Avg.\\ NEM (Percentile)",
  LM_PERCENTILE_MEAN  = "Avg.\\ Math--Language (Percentile)",
  VA_HEAD             = "School Value Add (SD)",
  ASSIGNED_ANY_MEAN   = "Any centralized assignment (\\%)",
  ASSIGNED_TOP10_MEAN = "Top-10\\% program assignment (\\%)",
  ASSIGNED_TOP25_MEAN = "Top-25\\% program assignment (\\%)",
  ASSIGNED_TOP50_MEAN = "Top-50\\% program assignment (\\%)"
)
records <- c(
  "\\begin{tabular}{lrr}", "\\toprule", " & Over-demanded & Other SAE \\\\", "\\midrule",
  map_chr(names(labels_a), function(v) {
    cells <- if (v == "VA_HEAD") sd3(panel_a[[v]]) else sprintf("%.1f", panel_a[[v]])
    paste0(labels_a[[v]], " & ", paste(cells, collapse = " & "), " \\\\")
  }),
  "\\midrule",
  paste0("Schools & ", paste(comma(panel_a$schools), collapse = " & "), " \\\\"),
  "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tabular}"
)
writeLines(records, "output/lottery_od_historical_records.tex")

va_checks <- c(
  "\\begin{tabular}{lrrr}", "\\toprule", " & Over-demanded & Other SAE & Difference \\\\", "\\midrule",
  unlist(imap(checks, function(g, label) c(
    paste0(label, " & ", sd3(g$mean[1]), " & ", sd3(g$mean[2]), " & ", sd3(g$mean[1] - g$mean[2]), " \\\\"),
    paste0(" & & & (", sprintf("%.3f", sqrt(g$se[1]^2 + g$se[2]^2)), ") \\\\")
  ))),
  "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tabular}"
)
writeLines(va_checks, "output/lottery_od_historical_va_checks.tex")
```

```{r tableA3-macros}
groups <- catalogue %>% group_by(GROUP) %>% summarise(schools = n(), observed = sum(IS_HISTORICAL), common = sum(IS_COMMON))
rates <- catalogue %>%
  mutate(completions = COMPLETIONS_2013 + COMPLETIONS_2015, takers = TAKERS_2013 + TAKERS_2015, linked = LINKED_2013 + LINKED_2015) %>%
  group_by(GROUP) %>%
  summarise(take = mean(takers[completions > 0] / completions[completions > 0]),
            link = mean(linked[takers > 0] / takers[takers > 0]),
            stayers = sum(STAYERS[linked > 0]) / sum(linked[linked > 0]))
fit_schools <- filter(schools, !is.na(VA_HEAD))   # the value-added regression's schools, all SAE schools
head_va <- checks[["Main estimate (Panel A)"]]

historical <- c(
  NEMOD = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$NEM_PERCENTILE_MEAN[1]), NEMOther = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$NEM_PERCENTILE_MEAN[2]),
  LanguageMathOD = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$LM_PERCENTILE_MEAN[1]), LanguageMathOther = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$LM_PERCENTILE_MEAN[2]),
  AnyOD = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$ASSIGNED_ANY_MEAN[1]), AnyOther = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$ASSIGNED_ANY_MEAN[2]),
  TopTenOD = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$ASSIGNED_TOP10_MEAN[1]), TopTenOther = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$ASSIGNED_TOP10_MEAN[2]),
  TopQuarterOD = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$ASSIGNED_TOP25_MEAN[1]), TopQuarterOther = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$ASSIGNED_TOP25_MEAN[2]),
  TopHalfOD = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$ASSIGNED_TOP50_MEAN[1]), TopHalfOther = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$ASSIGNED_TOP50_MEAN[2]),
  ODAssigned = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$ASSIGNED_ANY_MEAN[1]), OtherAssigned = sprintf("%.1f", panel_a$ASSIGNED_ANY_MEAN[2]),
  ODEligible = comma(groups$schools[1]), OtherEligible = comma(groups$schools[2]),
  ODObserved = comma(groups$observed[1]), OtherObserved = comma(groups$observed[2]),
  ODOutside = comma(sum(schools$IS_OD & !schools$IN_CATALOGUE)),
  ODCommon = comma(groups$common[1]), OtherCommon = comma(groups$common[2])
)
value_added <- c(
  OD = sd3(head_va$mean[1], "\\ensuremath{%s}"), Other = sd3(head_va$mean[2], "\\ensuremath{%s}"),
  Gap = sd3(head_va$mean[1] - head_va$mean[2], "\\ensuremath{%s}"),
  ODSchools = comma(head_va$schools[1]), OtherSchools = comma(head_va$schools[2]),
  ODStudents = comma(head_va$students[1]), OtherStudents = comma(head_va$students[2]),
  FitStudents = comma(sum(fit_schools$VA_N_HEAD)), FitSchools = comma(nrow(fit_schools)), FitSAESchools = comma(nrow(fit_schools)),
  ODTakeRate = sprintf("%.0f", 100 * rates$take[1]), OtherTakeRate = sprintf("%.0f", 100 * rates$take[2]),
  ODLinkRate = sprintf("%.0f", 100 * rates$link[1]), OtherLinkRate = sprintf("%.0f", 100 * rates$link[2]),
  ODStayers = sprintf("%.0f", 100 * rates$stayers[1]), OtherStayers = sprintf("%.0f", 100 * rates$stayers[2]),
  ChecksThirtyOD = comma(checks[["Schools with 30 or more graduates"]]$schools[1]),
  ChecksThirtyOther = comma(checks[["Schools with 30 or more graduates"]]$schools[2]),
  ChecksThirteenOD = comma(checks[["Class of 2013 only"]]$schools[1]), ChecksThirteenOther = comma(checks[["Class of 2013 only"]]$schools[2]),
  ChecksFifteenOD = comma(checks[["Class of 2015 only"]]$schools[1]), ChecksFifteenOther = comma(checks[["Class of 2015 only"]]$schools[2])
)
macros <- c(sprintf("\\newcommand{\\SAEHistorical%s}{%s}", names(historical), historical),
            sprintf("\\newcommand{\\SAEValueAdded%s}{%s}", names(value_added), value_added))
writeLines(macros, "output/lottery_od_historical_macros.tex")

cat(records, va_checks, macros, sep = "\n")
```

# Numbers in Section V's text and Appendix C's prose

The comments name the subsection of Section V that quotes each number; the last table gives each number as the text writes it, with
its file, its line and the words just before it.

```{r text-counts}
# V.A: the over-demanded schools and the children
outside <- filter(panel, !LOTTERY_SAMPLE)   # a chance of 0 or 1
counts <- c(over_demanded_schools = sum(schools$IS_OD), applicants = nrow(panel), lottery_sample = nrow(lottery),
            every_characteristic = nrow(sample3), chance_0_or_1 = nrow(outside), chance_0 = sum(outside$CHANCE_GROUP == 0),
            chance_1 = sum(outside$CHANCE_GROUP == 100), offer = sum(lottery$OFFER == 1), no_offer = sum(lottery$OFFER == 0))
counts

# V.A, the footnote on the placements: the 9th-grade main-stage placements at the 1,045 schools in the 2016-2021 processes; the share
# with no priority (the regular category), and the schools where a random number decided at least one seat taken with no priority:
# a seat filled by priority tier and random number (every seat but those filled through a school's special-education or
# academic-track ordering, and the guaranteed return of current students)
placements <- filter(applications, !is.na(RBD_ADMITIDO))
no_priority <- filter(placements, PRIORITY_CATEGORY == "regular")
seat_types <- c("2016 pilot list", "S ordering", "S tier and random number", "T ordering", "T tier and random number",
                "A high achiever, random number", "A tier and random number", "D low-income pool", "R regular pool", "G guaranteed return")

footnote <- c(placements = nrow(placements), no_priority = nrow(no_priority), share_no_priority = nrow(no_priority) / nrow(placements),

footnote[names(footnote) != "share_no_priority"]
c(share_no_priority_pct = 100 * footnote[["share_no_priority"]])

# V.B: without the offer, the entry-year destinations of the children whose attendance depends on it (Table C.3), in % with their SEs
est_c3 %>%
  transmute(type, share_pct = 100 * share, se_pp = 100 * se, n) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# V.B: the effects (pp) as shares of the means without an offer (%), on time and ever
shares <- est3 %>%
  filter(var %in% c(paste0(c("GRAD", "APPLIED", "ASSIGNED", "INSUA"), "_OT"), paste0(c("GRAD", "ASSIGNED", "INSUA"), "_EVER"))) %>%
  transmute(var, effect_pp = 100 * est, se_pp = 100 * se, p, n, mean_pct = 100 * mean, pct_of_mean = 100 * abs(est) / mean)
as.data.frame(shares)
```

## The footnote to the admission-scores table

The offer's effect on having each score, balance among the children with each score, and the trimmed estimates.

```{r text-footnote}
coverage <- mutate(sample3, HAS_LM = flag(as.integer(!is.na(LM_Z_MAX)), "HAS_LM"),
                   HAS_NEM = flag(as.integer(!is.na(NEM_Z_LATEST)), "HAS_NEM"), HAS_RANK = flag(as.integer(!is.na(RANK_Z_LATEST)), "HAS_RANK"))
coverage_est <- feols(c(HAS_LM, HAS_NEM, HAS_RANK) ~ OFFER + .[controls] + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP, coverage) %>%
  effect(c("HAS_LM", "HAS_NEM", "HAS_RANK")) %>%
  mutate(score = names(scores), mean = colMeans(coverage[coverage$OFFER == 0, c("HAS_LM", "HAS_NEM", "HAS_RANK")]))
coverage_est %>%
  transmute(score, effect_pp = 100 * est, se_pp = 100 * se, p, n, mean_pct = 100 * mean) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# the NEM and ranking samples are the same children
score_samples <- list("reading-mathematics" = filter(sample3, !is.na(LM_Z_MAX)),
                      "NEM and ranking" = filter(sample3, !is.na(NEM_Z_LATEST)))
joint_scores <- map(score_samples, joint_test, rhs = "+ i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP")
as.data.frame(bind_rows(joint_scores, .id = "sample"))
balance_scores <- map(score_samples, function(d) effect(feols(.[balance_vars] ~ OFFER + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP, d), balance_vars))
bind_rows(balance_scores, .id = "sample") %>%
  mutate(var = rep(balance_vars, length(score_samples)), .after = sample) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Abdulkadiroglu et al. (2017), footnote 16: drop whole chance groups, ranked by the z-statistic of the offered/non-offered
# gap in having the score, until the dropped children come closest to 5% of the lottery sample; the scores table's 2SLS on the rest
trim <- function(score) {
  ranked <- lottery %>%
    mutate(has = flag(as.integer(!is.na(.data[[score]])), paste("has", score))) %>%
    group_by(CHANCE_GROUP) %>%
    summarise(children = n(), gap = mean(has[OFFER == 1]) - mean(has[OFFER == 0]),
              se = sqrt(mean(has) * (1 - mean(has)) * (1 / sum(OFFER == 1) + 1 / sum(OFFER == 0)))) %>%
    mutate(z = ifelse(se > 0, abs(gap) / se, 0)) %>%
    arrange(desc(z), CHANCE_GROUP)
  k <- which.min(abs(c(0, cumsum(ranked$children)) - 0.05 * nrow(lottery))) - 1
  dropped <- ranked$CHANCE_GROUP[seq_len(k)]
  fit <- feols(as.formula(paste(score, "~ .[controls] + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP | D_OD ~ OFFER")),
               filter(sample3, !CHANCE_GROUP %in% dropped), ssc = ssc(K.adj = FALSE))
  mutate(effect(fit, score), groups = k, children = sum(ranked$children[seq_len(k)]))
}
trims <- bind_rows(map(names(scores), trim)) %>%
  mutate(score = names(scores), dropped_pct = 100 * children / nrow(lottery))
as.data.frame(trims)
```

# Every estimate at full precision

Written to `output/section5_estimates.csv` (17 significant digits), so that the tables can be checked against other runs.

```{r estimates}
outcome_rows <- function(est, table, column) transmute(est, table = table, column = column, variable = var, est, se, p, n, mean)
estimates <- bind_rows(
  bind_rows(map2(est2, c("(2)", "(3)", "(4)"), function(e, k) mutate(e, table = "III", column = k, variable = rows2$var))),
  tibble(table = "III", column = "(1)", variable = rows2$var, mean = unname(mean2[rows2$var])),
  transmute(joint2, table = "III", column = c("(2)", "(3)", "(4)"), variable = "joint F", est = .data$F, p, n),
  mutate(fs3, table = "IV", column = "first stage", variable = "D_OD"),
  outcome_rows(est3, "IV", "2SLS"),
  transmute(col1, table = "C.2", column = "(1)", variable = var, est, se, n),
  transmute(col1, table = "C.2", column = "(2)", variable = var, mean = mean_all, n),
  transmute(col3, table = "C.2", column = "(3)", variable = var, mean = mean3, n = n3),
  transmute(est_c3, table = "C.3", column = "without the offer", variable = type, est = share, se, n),
  outcome_rows(est_c4, "C.4", "OLS"),
  mutate(fs_c5, table = "C.5", column = "first stage", variable = "D_OD"),
  outcome_rows(est_c5, "C.5", "2SLS"),
  tibble(table = "counts", column = "C.1", variable = names(funnel), est = unname(funnel)),
  tibble(table = "counts", column = "C.2 note", variable = names(c2_counts), est = unname(c2_counts)),
  tibble(table = "counts", column = "text", variable = names(counts), est = unname(counts)),
  tibble(table = "counts", column = "footnote", variable = names(footnote), est = unname(footnote))
) %>%
  select(table, column, variable, est, se, p, n, mean)
estimates %>%
  mutate(across(c(est, se, p, mean), function(x) sprintf("%.17g", x))) %>%
  write.csv("output/section5_estimates.csv", row.names = FALSE)
nrow(estimates)
```
